recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical split-color background featuring a portrait of a subject in streetwear on the left, contrasted against a large, multi-layered bubble-letter logo that spans across the center-right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject on the left interacts with the negative space of the right-side logo
Vertical split background mirrors the color palette of the subject's clothing
Heavy black outlines on the logo provide separation from the vibrant background colors
coreInvariants: Subject wearing a varsity-style jacket and baseball cap
Large-scale, overlapping bubble typography with thick outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left third of the frame, medium shot from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white-bordered logo block in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves right to the large logo, then down the vertical split line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid color blocks on the right side provide a clean field for the graphic elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black used for heavy outlines and subject's clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White used for the primary logo border and highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high contrast; flat color fields without gradients.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-bold, rounded sans-serif with liquid-like connections.
letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight kerning with overlapping characters
Thick white outer stroke followed by a thinner black stroke
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are fused together into a single graphic shape
Internal counters are minimized to small slivers or circles
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single custom-lettered mark with no secondary text.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar rounded, heavy geometry for a starting skeleton
Circular counters and thick rounded strokes

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a person in a 90s varsity jacket and cap on the left side of a vertically split background (cyan on left, red on right).
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, two-line bubble-letter logo in the upper right. The top word should be red with a white outline, the bottom word cyan with a white outline. Encase the entire text block in a thick white border with a black edge.

verificationChecks: Is the background a sharp vertical split?
Does the text have a thick white 'cloud' border?
Are the letters overlapping and ultra-bold?

avoid: Realistic textures in the graphic elements

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is legible as a real brand name
Check that the white border around the text is continuous
Verify the vertical split is perfectly centered or slightly offset to the left
Confirm the subject's cap is tilted or worn in a 90s style
